descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
REVELSI is a global cybersecurity, AI, software, and infrastructure services organization. We work with worldwide enterprises to design, build, secure, and operate the systems their business depends on.
 Our top priority is safeguarding the fast-evolving global infrastructures and technologies.
 We integrate cybersecurity into infrastructure development and operational processes, alongside software development and AI-driven products, to proactively stay at the leading edge of industry advancements.
 REVELSI TEAM 
 At REVELSI , we combine deep technical expertise with a Silicon Valley-inspired mindset: agile, innovative, and collaborative.
 We’re a collaborative team that values performance and a positive work environment. We are committed to delivering high-quality results, supporting each other, and fostering a professional and friendly atmosphere.
 We’re looking for a team player with specialized skills, ready to grow and make an impact alongside experts in cybersecurity, network design, architecture, AI & software development, and IT management.
 You’ll collaborate with experienced IT (Security) professionals, expand your skills, and enjoy the journey in a team that embraces challenges with energy and enthusiasm . 
 YOUR DAY TO DAY: 
Be the point of contact for IT support, helping internal users resolve technical issues via phone and email
Manage, track and update incidents and service requests through the ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution
Escalate critical issues efficiently, following established processes and procedures
Deliver clear, comprehensive guidance during remote sessions, with a user-focused and empathetic approach
Keep the knowledge base up to date, contributing with new insights and solutions
Share knowledge and support team colleagues, including helping, guiding and mentoring new colleagues, if needed
Collaborate closely with upper-level teams to resolve complex issues
Create a positive user experience through effective and emphatic communication and problem-solving skills
 YOUR PROFILE: 
Degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent
Around 1+ years of experience in technical support or similar role
Comfortable providing technical support using help desk tools and remote support environments
Solid troubleshooting skills (Windows & Microsoft 365)
Strong communication skills in both English and Romanian, written and spoken
Strong communication skills with a customer-focused approach
Ability to work in a dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Continuous learning mindset and drive for professional growth
Willing to work in a 24/7 shift-based environment, including day shifts (07:00–18:00 / 08:00–19:00), night shifts (19:00–06:00 / 20:00–07:00), and occasional flex hours (15:00–00:00), within a structured schedule that includes a dedicated one-hour lunch break
 WE VALUE OUR EMPLOYEES: 
 At REVELSI , we create an environment that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance:
Private healthcare & medical insurance
Private dental services
Meal vouchers
Referral bonus program
Learning & development opportunities
Team buildings & events
Pizza day and free drinks at the office
Seasonal gifts (Christmas / Easter)
21 days PTO, increasing up to 25 based on seniority
 Ready to Join Us?
 Click “Apply” and let’s get started!
 Every day is an opportunity to grow and go beyond our limits! We embrace challenges and succeed together as a team—because great things happen when we collaborate.
